annotations.title: Avalanche danger level at a place

description: The danger level where someone is going in the Alps, from the official avalanche bulletin: give a place name or the name of a warning region, or lat and lon, or a region id. The elevation of a named place or point is looked up unless you give elevationM. atPlace holds the level for that elevation and time of day and the avalanche problems there; reports hold who issued the bulletin, when, until when and when the next is due, all its ratings and problems, and its texts: main message, danger description, snowpack, weather and tendency. Set when=next for the following bulletin once it is out. Say the level from atPlace.levels with its elevation and time of day, the warning service, when it was issued and until when it applies. If problemsInTextOnly is true, the service names its avalanche problems in its texts only: read them from texts. If nearbyRegions is not empty, the place lies within 2 km of another region: name it with its own level, or that it has no report, since a tour may cross into it. If outsideDescribedElevation is true, the report describes this level at describedElevation only: say so, and do not apply the level to the place or call it lower there. If atPlace.regionsWithoutLevel is not empty, the place also lies in regions without a report: say that no level is available for them, and ask the user which side the tour is on if that matters.

aspect.description: Slope aspect: narrows the avalanche problems in atPlace.

detail.description: summary: ratings, problems and main message. full (default): all texts as plain text. original: also the bulletin as published.

elevationM.description: The elevation that matters, if not the one of the place itself.

lang.description: Language for region names and, if the service publishes in it, report texts. Default en.

lat.description: Latitude, WGS 84. topo^alpin covers the Alps only.

placeId.description: When query matched several places, the placeId of the one the user means, from that list. Give it together with the same query.

query.description: Name of a summit, hut, pass or town, or of an area such as Valais or Tyrol for all its warning regions, or of a warning region.

regionId.description: EAWS micro-region id, from avalanche_region or avalanche_coverage.

name: avalanche_bulletin

appUrl.description: Opens this in the topo^alpin app. Share it with the user.

ambiguousReason.description: Why levels lists several elevation bands. elevation_missing, elevation_not_covered: ask for the elevation. elevation_at_boundary: the place lies on the bound between two bands, and both levels apply; name both. A bound is a transition zone, not an exact line: near it, say that the level changes around there.

differsBetweenRegions.description: Regions at this place have different levels: the strictest counts.

levels.description: THE ANSWER: the danger level at this place and elevation, one row per time of day and report. Differs between earlier and later only if the report says so.

aspects.description: The level applies on these aspects only; empty means all.

describedElevation.description: The rating itself has no elevation; the report describes it at this elevation through its problems (SLF).

elevation.description: Metres as a number, or "treeline" as in the report. A missing bound is open. A bound belongs to both bands it separates, and it is a transition zone, not an exact line.

level.description: EAWS danger level 1 to 5; null for no_snow, no_rating.

mostExposedAspects.description: Météo-France: the aspects where the danger is greatest. The level applies on all aspects of its elevation band.

outsideDescribedElevation.description: True: the place lies outside describedElevation. Say that the report describes this level at that elevation and says nothing specific about the place. Never call it lower.

subdivision.description: SLF subdivision: minus, neutral or plus (3- , 3=, 3+).

treelineAssumedM.description: The report names the treeline; we took it to lie at this elevation.

problems.description: Avalanche problems at this elevation and aspect. Empty does not mean there are none: some services describe them in the text only.

comment.description: What the service writes about this problem.

coreZone.description: The sentence of the service on where this applies (SLF).

elevation.description: Metres as a number, or "treeline" as in the report. A missing bound is open. A bound belongs to both bands it separates, and it is a transition zone, not an exact line.

value.description: The EAWS value the service gives this problem, if any.

problemsInTextOnly.description: A report here describes its avalanche problems in its texts only: problems stays empty and the elevation and aspect filters cannot apply. Read the problems from texts of the report.

regionsWithoutLevel.description: The place also lies in these regions, and they have no report: levels comes from the other regions only. Say that for them no level is available, and ask the user which side the tour is on if that matters.

dataStale.description: True: the data is older than its source is refreshed, or the source reports a fault. Say that it may be outdated. null: unknown, not fresh.

dataUpdatedAt.description: When the data behind this answer was produced (ISO 8601, UTC; a date for a fixed release). With several sources, the oldest. null: unknown.

disclaimer.description: Pass this on with every danger level: errors in processing are possible.

missing.description: Present where a report is missing. Pass it on.

nearbyRegions.description: Other warning regions within 2 km of the place. A tour may cross into them: name them, with their own report or that they have none. atPlace does not include them.

appUrl.description: Opens this report in the topo^alpin app. Share it.

missingReason.description: Why there is no report. service_unavailable means we do not know: fetching it failed.

next.description: Present when the next report is not out yet: the current one still applies.

notice.description: Pass this on with the danger level.

alternatives.description: Other places or areas the query may mean, each with how to ask for it: the same query with its placeId, lat and lon, or query.

partialMatch.description: No place has the name asked for; this one has a longer name that contains it. Name the place you used, and ask the user if they may mean another.

type.description: peak, saddle, alpine_hut, wilderness_hut, shelter, tour_place (where our tours start or end), town, or point where lat and lon were given.

appUrl.description: Opens this report in the topo^alpin app. Share it.

missingReason.description: Why there is no report. service_unavailable means we do not know: fetching it failed.

appUrl.description: Opens this report in the topo^alpin app. Share it.

aspects.description: The level applies on these aspects only; empty means all.

elevation.description: Metres as a number, or "treeline" as in the report. A missing bound is open. A bound belongs to both bands it separates, and it is a transition zone, not an exact line.

level.description: EAWS danger level 1 to 5; null for no_snow, no_rating.

mostExposedAspects.description: Météo-France: the aspects where the danger is greatest. The level applies on all aspects of its elevation band.

subdivision.description: SLF subdivision: minus, neutral or plus (3- , 3=, 3+).

language.description: Language of the texts; translate them for the user if needed.

proof.description: Where the service states this licence.

license.description: The licence of the reports. null: the service names none.

nextUpdate.description: When the service announces the next report. Most do not: null then, and the report applies until validUntil.

problems.description: All avalanche problems of the report. Empty does not mean there are none: see problemsInTextOnly.

comment.description: What the service writes about this problem.

coreZone.description: The sentence of the service on where this applies (SLF).

elevation.description: Metres as a number, or "treeline" as in the report. A missing bound is open. A bound belongs to both bands it separates, and it is a transition zone, not an exact line.

value.description: The EAWS value the service gives this problem, if any.

problemsInTextOnly.description: This service describes avalanche problems in its texts only, so problems is empty: read them from texts.

regionIds.description: The regions asked about that it applies to.

report.description: The report as published, in CAAMLv6, with detail=original.

service.description: The warning service that issued it.

texts.description: Plain text as written by the service; a field it left empty is missing.

highlights.description: The main message of the service.

unscheduled.description: Issued or corrected outside the regular schedule.

sources.description: Name these when using the data.

status.description: Is there a report for this place at all? next: the following report, asked with when=next.
